task: Review this public-health bulletin excerpt from a fictional municipal authority. Identify the unsupported statistical claim and explain what evidence is missing before the claim can be made.
input: Hand hygiene improvements in our district have reduced community infections by 40 percent over the past two years.

facts.text: The bulletin is from a fictional municipal public-health authority.
The 40 percent figure appears in the bulletin without an identified source study.
The packet does not supply a before-and-after infection count or rate.
The packet does not supply a methodology linking hand-hygiene interventions to the stated reduction.

forbidden_additions: An invented source study or alternative percentage.
A confirmation that the 40 percent figure is plausible or within a typical range.
An alternative causal explanation for infection trends.
preserve: The identification of the missing source study for the 40 percent claim.
The separate observation that the before-and-after infection counts are absent.
The separate observation that a causal methodology is missing.
